stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 121 km apart and travel towards each other at 31 km/h and 59 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 31 + 59 = 90$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{121}{90} = 1.34$ hours.
